hero.name: Ebrahim Abdelghfar Ebrahim
hero.title: Robotics Software Engineer
hero.bio: A results-driven Robotics Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience designing and deploying software for autonomous mobile robots. Expertise in C++/Python, ROS/ROS2, and the NAV2 stack, delivering robust solutions from simulation to deployment.

experience.title: Robotics Software Engineer
details: Architected and implemented a complete navigation stack for an agricultural AMR using ROS2 and NAV2, achieving 0.7m odometry accuracy.
Engineered complex Gazebo simulation environments, reducing hardware testing cycles by 40%.
Containerized robotics applications using Docker, decreasing environment setup time by 75%.
Provided expert-level consultation on sensor selection and hardware integration.

experience.title: R&D Robotics Software Developer
details: Designed high-fidelity CoppeliaSim environments for Robo-cafe projects, reducing development costs by 30%.
Developed integration bridges between industrial PLCs and high-level ROS controllers.
Established the company's software development pipeline using Git.
Collaborated on developing the software layer for an IoT soil measurement station using ESP32 and MQTT.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant
experience.company: Faculty of engineering of Ain Shams university
details: Taught the "MCT443: Autonomous Systems" course to over 40 undergraduate students.
Mentored students on ROS2 implementation and core robotics algorithms.

experience.title: Autonomous System Mentor
details: Delivered training modules on autonomous systems, increasing implementation rates by 70%.
Engineered a milestones simulator using CoppeliaSim and ROS1.
Developed the Steering Control for an Autonomous Vehicle using Pure Pursuit.

education.title: M.Sc. in Mechatronics and Robotics Engineering
details: Currently pursuing advanced studies in robotics, focusing on cutting-edge research and development in autonomous systems.

projects.title: Shell Urban Autonomous Concept Simulator
projects.summary: A modular simulation framework with ROS 2 and Docker for testing navigation algorithms.
projects.description: Developed for efficient testing of autonomous navigation algorithms.
details: Engineered a modular simulation framework using ROS 2 Humble and Docker.
Implemented Docker containers to ensure consistent development environments and streamline deployment.
Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team to integrate sensor models and vehicle dynamics.
Contributed to documentation and user guides to facilitate broader adoption.

projects.title: Path Tracking Surveys
projects.summary: Applied and compared Pure-pursuit, Stanley, and MPC controllers in the CARLA simulator.
projects.description: A comparative study of different path tracking algorithms.
details: Applied Pure-pursuit, Stanley, and MPC to follow a track and compared the performance of each.
Tested algorithms on CARLA and integrated them using ROS2.
All implementations were done in Python.

projects.title: Self-Driving Car Simulator
projects.summary: Built a complete simulation environment for an Ackerman steering car with ROS1 integration.
projects.description: A high-fidelity simulation from the ground up.
details: Prepared a 3D Model of an Ackerman steering car using SolidWorks and converted it to URDF.
Built the simulation environment and tuned physics to achieve a low sim-to-real gap (10% error).
Added 3D Lidar, IMU, and GPS sensors and connected the environment with ROS1 using LUA.

projects.title: ABB IRB 120 Simulator
projects.summary: Integrated ROS1 and MoveIt with CoppeliaSim for an industrial robot arm, cited in a Master's thesis.
projects.description: A simulator for an industrial robotic arm that gained academic recognition.
details: The simulator bridge was cited in a Master's thesis in Italy.
Integrated ROS1 and MoveIt with CoppeliaSim.
Designed the complete simulation environment for the robot.

projects.title: Autonomous Disassembly Robotic Manipulator
projects.summary: A complex project for non-destructive e-waste disassembly, part of my graduation thesis.
projects.description: This was my graduation project, focusing on the non-destructive disassembly of e-waste.
details: Designed a software architecture that organizes workflow between 11 different algorithms.
Implemented an SDK that contains 10 different methods to facilitate dealing with MoveIt and frame transformation.
Facilitated algorithm testing by designing a digital twin environment using CoppeliaSim and ROS1.
Developed approach and unscrewing algorithm at which the success percentage reached 98%.
Developed a Screw localizing technique using YOLOv5 and a depth camera.
